videos.title: Power BI Copilot Set Up Verified Answers in 20 seconds
videos.description:
With verified answers, you pick the visual and Copilot uses it for related questions. Anyone who asks a similar question gets your approved chart, not a new guess.

How to set it up: select a visual, open the ... menu in its header and choose Set up a verified answer. Add five to seven trigger phrases, or take the ones Copilot suggests. Matching is semantic, so “sales by month” also catches “sales over time”.

Full guide, including schema cleanup and AI instructions here: https://datatraining.io

videos.title: 574 - Pick the open standard, not the proprietary one
videos.description:
574 - Building a proprietary ontology locks you into one way of thinking. The OSI group already has smart people working the spec, with Databricks and Snowflake at the table. Pick the thing that outlives your project.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #opensource #opensemanticinterchange #microsoftfabric #datastrategy

videos.title: 574 - Shop your ontology like a grocery store
videos.description:
574 - Walk the aisles of your ontology, pull a customer table, grab two metrics and a fact table, and watch a semantic model build itself in front of you. Hit checkout and it's yours. Direct Lake is what makes that possible.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #directlake #semanticmodel #microsoftfabric #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - Who gets to see which tables in your ontology?
videos.description:
574 - Finance tables linked to customer and sales are valid enterprise semantics. That doesn't mean the sales team should see them. Who's sanctioned for which tables in an ontology, and does this just become row-level security everywhere?

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #datasecurity #rowlevelsecurity #datagovernance #microsoftfabric

videos.title: 574 - Tag a table description to auto-join your ontology
videos.description:
574 - Drop a line in your table description that says for use in ontology A, weight 0.7. The ontology agent searches every description in Fabric and pulls the matches in on its own. No more hand-picking models one at a time.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #microsoftfabric #metadata #dataagents #semanticlayer

videos.title: 574 - You fixed one model. The other five didn't change
videos.description:
574 - You add descriptions and instructions to one semantic model to make it AI ready. Now where does that work go? Nothing today carries it up to the other five models with the same customers table.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#semanticmodel #powerbi #aiready #microsoftfabric #datamodeling

videos.title: 574 - Synapse and Data Factory are gone
videos.description:
574 - Someone asked about Data Factory this week. Synapse, resource groups, the way you used to do data engineering, all of it is gone. Medallion survived. The old mental model can't stretch to agents in Fabric.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#microsoftfabric #dataengineering #synapse #datafactory #aiagents

videos.title: 574 - Hot take: ontology is where the contract belongs
videos.description:
574 - The hot take: ontology is where the data agent contract layer belongs, not the semantic model and not the lakehouse. It needs a rewrite first, though. Think PBIP for ontologies, not one YAML file.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #microsoftfabric #dataagents #semanticlayer #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Two teams, same customer count, different answer
videos.description:
574 - One team filters three things out of customer count. Another team leaves those in and filters something else. Both call it customer count. If you say A and I hear B, the agent has no chance either.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#datagovernance #semanticlayer #metrics #aiagents #dataquality

videos.title: 574 - Give your measures a weight of seven
videos.description:
574 - Customer rollup A gets a weight of seven. Rollup B gets a three. That's how the agent knows which source wins when two measures look the same. Weights are a thing in AI, so why not in our metric definitions?

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#aiagents #datamodeling #metrics #semanticlayer #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - A semantic model today isn't a semantic model
videos.description:
574 - A semantic model today is two things wearing one name: the semantics and the data, welded together. Pull them apart and you need somewhere to put each one. Neither place really exists yet.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#semanticmodel #powerbi #microsoftfabric #datamodeling #lakehouse

videos.title: 574 - The lakehouse can't hold a measure
videos.description:
574 - Lakehouse tables go as wide and as tall as you want. They still can't hold a measure or a relationship, which is exactly what a semantic model needs. That gap puts the whole thing in a strange spot.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#lakehouse #semanticmodel #microsoftfabric #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Put every semantic model table in Direct Lake
videos.description:
574 - The ideal setup: every table in every semantic model coming out of the lakehouse, most of it in Direct Lake mode. Update the table and the model has it. Not realistic for every company, but here's why it's worth chasing.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#directlake #microsoftfabric #lakehouse #semanticmodel #powerbi

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Set invoice limits for time and material billing
items.description: Customers often issue a purchase order that sets how much they'll accept on each invoice for a time and material engagement. Until now, Dynamics 365 Project Operations had no place to record that amount, so project managers and billing teams tracked it in spreadsheets and checked invoices by hand, adding reconciliation work and the risk of disputes. You can now set an invoice amount limit for each billing period on a time and material contract line's invoice schedule: Enter the limit for each pe

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Segmentation of recordings and transcripts in Contact Center
items.description:
Enterprise customers, particularly in regulated industries and large distributed contact center environments operating across multiple business units, geographies, vendors, and service providers, require strict controls to ensure users can access only the recordings and transcripts relevant to their operational scope while maintaining appropriate supervisory and compliance visibility.
This feature enables segmentation of interaction data by organizational boundaries such as Business Units, Teams

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Deprecate transaction origins
items.description: Dynamics 365 Project Operations streamlines transaction processing by replacing separate transaction origin records with direct source document references on transaction records, including journal lines, actuals, and invoice line details. This approach reduces the database operations required to maintain links to originating time entries, expenses, and material usage logs, and enables the phased retirement of transaction origin record creation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Streamline the preboarding experience
items.description:
Business value
Preboarding gives candidates a clear, consistent way to complete requirements before their first day. HR teams can reduce manual follow-ups, repeated data entry, and delays caused by incomplete information by using a structured process with configured validation and document requirements. A guided experience helps candidates understand what to do next, while HR administrators maintain a repeatable process that supports day-one readiness.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Merge bank account financial dimensions when generating vouchers from bank reconciliation rules
items.description: When vouchers are generated through bank reconciliation rules, financial dimensions from the selected bank account are merged with the financial dimensions defined on the reconciliation rule. Dimensions specified on the reconciliation rule take precedence, while any dimensions that aren't specified on the rule automatically default from the bank account. This enhancement enables a single voucher-generation rule to be reused across multiple bank accounts, reducing setup and maintenance effort whi

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Release commerce orders from POS to the warehouse
items.description:
Business Value
For trade counter and call center operations, orders often need to reach the warehouse quickly so that picking and fulfillment activities can begin without delay. Without a direct path from Commerce to the warehouse management system, staff must manually intervene on every order, which slows fulfillment and increases the risk of missed or delayed shipments.
This feature removes that bottleneck by automatically releasing routine orders on a scheduled basis, eliminating repetitive m

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Improve order capture workflows in Store Commerce
items.description:
Business value
Every friction point in order capture adds time to each transaction and increases the risk of downstream errors. Context that has no field is lost. A customer order converts to a cash-and-carry sale when all lines are marked as carryout, which removes flexibility that trade counter staff depend on. Standing values such as a customer's purchase order number are retyped on every transaction. This release is designed to address those friction points.

items.description:
This feature provides label printing in Store Commerce. Store associates print labels in the store, either on demand or from a label print request sent by Commerce headquarters when prices or promotions change. Headquarters is where administrators configure label formats and the printers available to each store, and where headquarters users create and release those requests. The first release covers three stages.
Set up in Commerce headquarters. An administrator defines label formats in the labe

items.description:
This feature provides reusable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for Store Commerce shift and cash management, exposing Commerce capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and developers can compose into agentic experiences.
The tools enable agentic experiences to list a store's registers and drawers; scan current shift status, including open, suspended, blind-closed, and invalid shifts; list shifts opened in a requested period, including those now closed; retrieve structured

items.title: Work IQ: Execute (Recipes)
items.description: Enable agents to execute reusable Work IQ recipes that coordinate supported tools and actions.

items.title: Work IQ: Federated connectors
items.description: Enable Work IQ to use federated connectors for governed access to additional enterprise data sources.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

Microsoft Teams: Multiple screen shares
in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: You can now view up to two shared screens side by side during meetings, reducing interruptions from screen hand-offs. Participants can switch between side-by-side and expanded views, identify presenters for each screen, and benefit from layouts optimized for single or dual displays. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.description:
Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.
Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered int

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
items.description:
Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.
Administrators configure natural language playbooks using conversation orchestration at the global or inbound profile level to specify the action to run when a direct inward dialed call can't be attended to or completed. The actions inclu

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description: Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. items.title: Power Pages: SDK (Software Development Kit)
items.description: Build native mobile applications or kiosks using Power Pages as the backend foundation with support for authentication, authorization, APIs, data access, and reusable mobile capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Analyze adherence history to optimize workforce planning
items.description:
The Adherence History Report provides a complete view of customer service representatives’ historical adherence to scheduled tasks and activities. It helps supervisors analyze patterns, identify gaps, and improve workforce efficiency.
Key capabilities
Trend chart: Visualize adherence patterns for individual service representatives or the entire team over time.
Metrics dashboard: Track adherence percentage, total scheduled time, and time spent out of adherence.
Activity summary view: Access detai

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Handle waiting conversations when queues close or become unstaffed
items.description:
This capability enhances queue handling by intelligently detecting two key scenarios where conversations would otherwise remain unserved:

Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. If the queue transitions to out-of-operating hours while conversations are still waiting, it automatically applies admin-defined overflow actions. Customers can be guided to leave a voicemail, request a callback, or be t

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Assign conversation to expert who engaged with the customer previously
items.description: Assign to a previously engaged or preferred expert leverages historical interaction context, queue membership alignment, and expert availability, to ensure customers are reconnected with experts who already understand their issue. When the previous or preferred expert is unavailable, assignments seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified expert, preserving service levels and reliability. This capability reduces repeat explanations, accelerates resolution times, and improves customer satisfa

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
items.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description:
Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive
The new Prompt Gallery offers ready-to-use prompts for common file tasks, helping you get started quickly, discover what Copilot can do, and customize prompts to fit your needs.
Access the Prompt Gallery from:
The Copilot button in the bottom-right corner of OneDrive
The + button in the Copilot chat pane
Select Open Prompt Gallery to explore prompts across categories such as Create, Analyze, Find, and Collaborate.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Planner: Local Custom Fields/Columns
items.description: Custom Fields let you tailor your plans to match the way your team works. Add Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, and Choice fields to capture the information that matters most. View and update custom fields across Board, Grid, and Task details, with support for sorting, filtering, grouping, and bulk editing to keep your work organized and easy to manage.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
items.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.
